item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
Issued at 10:00 AM 13 September 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #CamarinesSur(Gainza, Camaligan, Milaor, Minalabac, SanFernando, Bula, Tigaon, Sagñay, Baao, IrigaCity, Presentacion, Caramoan, Nabua and Balatan) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #CamarinesNorte, #CamarinesSur(Siruma, Tinambac, Goa, Lagonoy, Garchitorena, Calabanga, NagaCity, Pili, Ocampo, Bombon, Magarao, DelGallego, Ragay, Lupi, Sipocot, Cabusao, Libmanan, Canaman, Pamplona and Pasacao) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
